# USR-002: No login account has an empty password

- **Group:** Users and privilege
- **Severity when it fails:** critical
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check may report `unknown`; it never reports a pass it could not verify.

## Why it matters

An account with an empty password hash and a login shell lets anyone in who can reach a login prompt, including the console and su. stackward reads the status with `passwd -S -a`, which prints a letter per account and never a hash.

## Verify by hand

```sh
sudo passwd -S -a
```

## How to fix it

Lock the account with `passwd -l <user>` or set a password.

Run `stackward explain USR-002` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
